column1: # seasonal-transport bbox coverage check in scripts/validate_data.py.
# Each row suppresses exactly one (x, y, z) seasonal-transport
# endpoint that classifies NEUTRAL through the curated bboxes while
# carrying no `Region override` cell. In each case the tile's chunk
# region id is absent from the committed generated
# leagues/regions.tsv, so the plugin's LeagueRegionChecker falls
# back to NEUTRAL (always-unlocked) — upstream rows the display
# info itself labels with a league region. The real fix is an
# upstream `Region override` cell (or a regenerated regions.tsv);
# these exceptions record the known gap so new NEUTRAL-classifying
